如何用 Foxit PDF SDK 将注释移动到 PDF 坐标系中的新位置
```javascript
const FSDK = require("@foxitsoftware/foxit-pdf-sdk-node");
const fs = require('fs');
const os = require('os');
const path = require('path');

var sn = "";
var key = "";

let error_code = FSDK.Library.Initialize(sn, key);
if (FSDK.e_ErrSuccess != error_code) {
 if (FSDK.e_ErrInvalidLicense == error_code)
 console.log("[Failed] Current used Foxit PDF SDK key information is invalid.");
 else
 console.log("Library Initialize Error: %d", FSDK.e_ErrSuccess);
 return;
}

// 加载PDF文档.
let doc = new FSDK.PDFDoc("input_file.pdf");
error_code = doc.Load("");
if (error_code != FSDK.e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
}
let page = doc.GetPage(0);
let iAnnotCount = page.getAnnotCount();
for (let j = 0; j < iAnnotCount; j++) {
 let pAnnot = page.GetAnnot(j);
 let annotType = pAnnot.GetType();
 let orgRect = pAnnot.GetRect();
 let newRect = new RectF();
 newRect.left = orgRect.left;
 newRect.bottom = orgRect.bottom;
 if (FSDK.Annot.e_Popup != annotType) {
 newRect.left += fDelta;
 newRect.bottom += fDelta;
 }
 newRect.right = orgRect.right + fDelta;
 newRect.top = orgRect.top + fDelta;
 pAnnot.Move(newRect);
}
doc.SaveAs("output_file.pdf", FSDK.PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
FSDK.Library.Release();
```

如何用 Foxit PDF SDK 实现多个签名共享签名数据

```javascript
const FSDK = require("@foxitsoftware/foxit-pdf-sdk-node");
const fs = require('fs');
const os = require('os');
const path = require('path');

var sn = "";
var key = "";

let error_code = FSDK.Library.Initialize(sn, key);
if (FSDK.e_ErrSuccess != error_code) {
 if (FSDK.e_ErrInvalidLicense == error_code)
 console.log("[Failed] Current used Foxit PDF SDK key information is invalid.");
 else
 console.log("Library Initialize Error: %d", FSDK.e_ErrSuccess);
 return;
}

// 加载PDF文档.
let doc = new FSDK.PDFDoc("blank.pdf");
error_code = doc.Load("");
if (error_code != FSDK.e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
}
 let page = doc.GetPage(0);
 let sigRect = new FSDK.RectF(0, 400, 200, 475);
 let pNewSig = page.AddSignature(sigRect);
 pNewSig.SetKeyValue(FSDK.Signature.e_KeyNameSigner, "Neko");
 pNewSig.SetKeyValue(FSDK.Signature.e_KeyNameReason, "For test");
 pNewSig.GenerateAppearance();
 let sigRect1 = new FSDK.RectF(200, 200, 400, 275);
 let sign1 = page.AddSignatureWithExistedVDict(sigRect1, "test1", FSDK.Signature.e_SignatureTypeOrdinary, false, pNewSig);
 sign1.SetKeyValue(FSDK.Signature.e_KeyNameSigner, "Jack");
 sign1.SetKeyValue(FSDK.Signature.e_KeyNameReason, "For test GSDK");
 sign1.GenerateAppearance();
 pNewSig.StartSign("foxit_all.pfx", "123456", FSDK.Signature.e_DigestSHA1, "Signed.pdf", null, null);
 FSDK.Library.Release();

```

---

如何用 Foxit PDF SDK 获取设备坐标系中的注释矩形

```javascript
const FSDK = require("@foxitsoftware/foxit-pdf-sdk-node");
const fs = require('fs');
const os = require('os');
const path = require('path');

var sn = "";
var key = "";

let error_code = FSDK.Library.Initialize(sn, key);
if (FSDK.e_ErrSuccess != error_code) {
 if (FSDK.e_ErrInvalidLicense == error_code)
 console.log("[Failed] Current used Foxit PDF SDK key information is invalid.");
 else
 console.log("Library Initialize Error: %d", FSDK.e_ErrSuccess);
 return;
}

// 加载PDF文档.
let doc = new FSDK.PDFDoc("input_file.pdf");
error_code = doc.Load("");
if (error_code != FSDK.e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
}
let page = doc.GetPage(0);
let width = page.GetPageWidth();
let height = page.GetPageHeight();
const bmpWidth = [width, 2 * width];
const bmpHeight = [height, 2 * height];
for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
 let setMatrix = page.GetDisplayMatrix(0, 0, bmpWidth[i], bmpHeight[i], FSDK.e_Rotation0);
 let iAnnotCount = page.GetAnnotCount();
 for (let j = 0; j < iAnnotCount; j++) {
 let pAnnot = page.GetAnnot(j);
 let deviceRect = pAnnot.GetDeviceRect(setMatrix);
 }
}

FSDK.Library.Release();

```

如何用 Foxit PDF SDK 在 PDF 坐标系中获取指定位置上的注释
```javascript
const FSDK = require("@foxitsoftware/foxit-pdf-sdk-node");
const fs = require('fs');
const os = require('os');
const path = require('path');

var sn = "";
var key = "";

let error_code = FSDK.Library.Initialize(sn, key);
if (FSDK.e_ErrSuccess != error_code) {
 if (FSDK.e_ErrInvalidLicense == error_code)
 console.log("[Failed] Current used Foxit PDF SDK key information is invalid.");
 else
 console.log("Library Initialize Error: %d", FSDK.e_ErrSuccess);
 return;
}

// 加载PDF文档.
let doc = new FSDK.PDFDoc("input_file.pdf");
error_code = doc.Load("");
if (error_code != FSDK.e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
}
let page = doc.GetPage(0);
let point = new FSDK.PointF(350.94733, 450.00256);
let annot = page.GetAnnotAtPoint(point, 0);
FSDK.Library.Release();
```

---

如何用 Foxit PDF SDK 将 PDF 转换为 RTF 文件？

不，该 SDK 不提供将 PDF 文件转换为 RTF 文件的功能。

---

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to Get the annotation at a specified position in device coordinate system.
```javascript
const FSDK = require("@foxitsoftware/foxit-pdf-sdk-node");
const fs = require('fs');
const os = require('os');
const path = require('path');

var sn = "";
var key = "";

let error_code = FSDK.Library.Initialize(sn, key);
if (FSDK.e_ErrSuccess != error_code) {
 if (FSDK.e_ErrInvalidLicense == error_code)
 console.log("[Failed] Current used Foxit PDF SDK key information is invalid.");
 else
 console.log("Library Initialize Error: %d", FSDK.e_ErrSuccess);
 return;
}

// 加载PDF文档.
let doc = new FSDK.PDFDoc("input_file.pdf");
error_code = doc.Load("");
if (error_code != FSDK.e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
}
let page = doc.GetPage(0);
let point = new FSDK.PointF(5.0, 5.0);
let matrix = page.GetDisplayMatrix(0, 0, page.GetWidth(), page.GetHeight(), FSDK.e_Rotation0);
let annot = page.GetAnnotAtDevicePoint(point, 0, matrix);
FSDK.Library.Release();
```

---

如何用 Foxit PDF SDK 向 PDF 文件添加目录 (Table of Contents)

const FSDK = require("@foxitsoftware/foxit-pdf-sdk-node");
const fs = require('fs');
const os = require('os');
const path = require('path');

var sn = "";
var key = "";

let error_code = FSDK.Library.Initialize(sn, key);
if (FSDK.e_ErrSuccess != error_code) {
 if (FSDK.e_ErrInvalidLicense == error_code)
 console.log("[Failed] Current used Foxit PDF SDK key information is invalid.");
 else
 console.log("Library Initialize Error: %d", FSDK.e_ErrSuccess);
 return;
}

// 加载PDF文档.
let doc = new FSDK.PDFDoc("Bookmark.pdf");
error_code = doc.Load("");
if (error_code != FSDK.e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
}
let toc_config = new FSDK.TableOfContentsConfig();
toc_config.include_toc_pages = false;
toc_config.title = L"Table of Contents";
toc_config.is_show_serial_number = true;
toc_config.bookmark_level_array = new FSDK.Int32Array();
let depth = doc.GetBookmarkLevelDepth();
if (depth > 0) {
 if (depth > 5) depth = 5;
 for (let i = 1; i <= depth; i++) {
 toc_config.bookmark_level_array.Add(i);
 }
}
doc.AddTableOfContents(toc_config);
doc.SaveAs("TOC.pdf",FSDK.PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNormal);
FSDK.Library.Release();
